method: Computed cascade in headless Chrome on a seeded scratch copy (main, recording, tags, settings, onboarding step 0). For every rule in a template <style> block and every longhand it sets, each element it matches is checked for which rule wins (importance, specificity, source order; :hover/:focus states compared as subsets). manage_tags.html is not rendered by any route (/project/<id>/tags/manage redirects to tags?edit=1).

cause.order: equal specificity, shared sheet wins only because it is linked after the <style> block
cause.specificity: shared selector is more specific; link order does not matter
